offers.description: Compare two or three candidate San Francisco sites across the same released permit, planning, enforcement, and zoning evidence dimensions, with bounded evidence highlights, completeness metadata, source gaps, official-source provenance manifests, and machine-readable drilldowns, without selecting a winner.

description: Paid $0.49 USD. Compare two or three distinct candidate San Francisco sites across the same released evidence dimensions without selecting a winner. Use this for side-by-side site evidence; use build_property_intelligence_pack for one site. Unsupported or held jurisdictions fail before payment.

inputSchema.description: Compare two or three distinct candidate sites using the same released LocalProof evidence dimensions.

sites.description: Two or three candidate sites to compare. Each site must resolve to a distinct supported property.

address.description: Street address or place to resolve. Include locality information when available.

city.description: Optional city used to disambiguate the address and route it to a supported LocalProof jurisdiction.

label.description: Optional short label used to identify this candidate in the comparison result.

state.description: Optional state name or abbreviation. Current released jurisdictions are in California; use CA or California.

unit.description: Optional unit, suite, or apartment identifier when it is relevant to property identity.

name: localproof.compare_sites
title: Compare Sites
